text: My kids deserve a better mom than me, maybe they'd be happier if I disappeared.
When she won't stop screaming I get scared of what I might do to her.
I had to stop halfway up the stairs because I couldn't get enough air.
My heart is doing flip-flops and my neck and jaw feel strange.
I bled through my pad and my pants in the last hour.
There was a dark patch in the middle of what I could see for a while.
The back of my lower leg feels tight and warm to touch.
My head has been splitting for three days and nothing helps.
My wedding band is stuck and my lips feel tingly and fat.
I miss my friends but we video chatted today, which was nice.
I felt sad for a bit when the baby's onesie stopped fitting. They grow so fast.
Took the baby to the park and sat in the sun for a while.
Spit up on my last clean shirt, laundry day I guess.
My wrists ache a little from holding her head during feeds.
